entries.heading: Of the unobligated amounts made available for fiscal
ancestors: DIVISION G—TRANSPORTATION, HOUSING AND URBAN DEVELOPMENT, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2019
entries.text:
Sec. 164.  Of the unobligated amounts made available for fiscal 
years 2005 or prior fiscal years to ``Transit Formula Grants'', a total 
of $46,560,000 is hereby permanently rescinded.
